pattern: SVG time-series chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "candlestick chart") of role="img" candles with roving focus along the sessions; a legend of toggle buttons for moving averages; zoom toolbar; data table fallback.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription "candlestick chart" (localized), named by the title
img with an aria-label: date, open, high, low, close, change
list of toggle buttons (aria-pressed) for moving averages
table (native) with caption, column headers, and row headers

roles.element: axes, volume pane, averages, crosshair, tooltip
roles.role: aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
0 on exactly one mark (roving); other marks have none
Table open state and the table region id
Localized: date, open, high, low, close, change

keyboard.action: Previous / next session (swapped in RTL); past the window edge a zoomed chart pans.
Ten sessions back / forward (clamped to the visible window).
Zoom in / out around the focused mark (announced politely, aui-zoom).
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
One tab stop for the plot (the active mark), the zoom buttons, the legend buttons, then the Show data table button and the table region.

focus: Roving focus: one candle is in the tab sequence and keeps the last visited session across re-renders, zoom, and pan.
notes: Direction is shown by shape (hollow rising, filled falling candles; dashed falling OHLC bars) and named in each accessible name ("up 1.2 %"), never by color alone.
Zoom and pan have keyboard and button equivalents for every pointer gesture (WCAG 2.5.7).
The generated summary names the range, the change from first to last close, the extremes, and any sessions not plotted on non-trading days.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
